 Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India,
 issuance of a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, to call for the records rela
 the impugned order passed by the fourth respondent in his proceedings in
 R.No.4049/2018/S1/FSSA/41-15 dated 03.07.2018 and quash the same as
 illegal and consequently to direct the fourth respondent to absorb and regu
 the service of the petitioner as Food Safety Officer in the fourth responde
 Department within the period that may be stipulated by this Court. 
 For Petitioner : Mr.B.Vishnu Chelliya 
 For Respondents : Mr.R.Murthi
 Government Advocate
 for R1 and R3
 Mr.E.Sundaram
 Government Advocate
 for R2, R4 and R5
 ____________
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
 Page No. 2 of 5

 W.P.No.187
 Order
The learned counsel for the petitioner filed a letter, dated 22.07.2024, seeking permission of this Court to withdraw this petition and he also made an endorsement to that effect in the Court bundle. 
2. In view of the same, this Writ Petition stands dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently,
connected writ miscellaneous petitions are closed.
